scripts.dev: HEARTH_HOME="${HEARTH_HOME:-$PWD/.dev}" concurrently --kill-others --names daemon,app --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "pnpm dev:daemon" "pnpm dev:app"
scripts.web: pnpm build && HEARTH_HOME="${HEARTH_HOME:-$PWD/.dev}" cargo run -q -p hearth-cli -- open
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && pnpm typecheck
